actions.name: Exploit CVE-2023-27350 to bypass authentication and execute remote code
actions.description: Malicious actors exploited CVE-2023-27350 beginning in mid-April 2023 and continuing through the present, allowing unauthenticated remote code execution on vulnerable PaperCut MF and NG servers.

actions.name: Access PaperCut server as administrator via SetupCompleted Java class authentication bypass
actions.description: Actors bypass user authentication by exploiting improper access controls in the SetupCompleted Java class, gaining administrator access to the PaperCut server.

actions.name: Execute remote code using PaperCut print scripting interface
actions.description: Use the print scripting interface to execute shell commands on the compromised PaperCut server.

actions.name: Execute remote code using User/Group Sync interface living-off-the-land attack
actions.description: Use the User/Group Sync interface to execute a living-off-the-land-style attack on the compromised PaperCut server.

actions.name: Spawn child processes cmd.exe or powershell.exe with SYSTEM/root privileges
actions.description: Exploit PaperCut server process pc-app.exe running with SYSTEM/root privileges to spawn child processes such as cmd.exe or powershell.exe with the same privileges for post-exploitation activity.

actions.name: Download and execute legitimate remote management and maintenance (RMM) software
actions.description: Download and execute legitimate RMM software on victim systems via commands issued through PaperCut’s print scripting interface.

actions.name: Use Tor and other proxies for external network communications to mask malicious traffic
actions.description: Use Tor and/or other proxies from inside victim networks to mask malicious network traffic.

actions.name: Download and execute command and control (C2) malware such as DiceLoader, TrueBot, and Cobalt Strike Beacons
actions.description: Download and execute C2 malware including DiceLoader, TrueBot, and Cobalt Strike Beacons during the attack.

actions.name: Leave ransom notes demanding payment for decryption
actions.description: Bl00dy Ransomware Gang left ransom notes on victim systems demanding payment in exchange for decryption of encrypted files.

relations.rationale: authentication bypass enables access as administrator
RCE via print scripting interface after admin access
RCE via User/Group Sync interface after admin access
RMM software downloaded and executed via commands issued through print scripting interface
